answer: The nadir schedule is applied in kernel and copper publishes each instalment. A payout is split so that 50% arrives at settlement and the rest over 16 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An farming party therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3023 identities would post 2204 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
